variants.candidate: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Earth makes it steady, so what you claim lasts. As a catalyst, the wanting outruns the keeping, and you chase the next venture instead of holding what you have. You end up owning far less than you built.
variants.original: Earth is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is where your reach becomes something held: savings, property, positions, commitments that stay put. You do best when ambition lands somewhere concrete.

variants.candidate: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Wood makes it growth, a reach fed by what goes in. Running thin, you carry everything alone rather than lean on a peer, or race the one ahead with no reserve. You run out before the thing is done.
variants.original: Wood is your Body, and running thin, it is the growth reserve your whole system draws on: appetite, stamina, the will to start things. When it dips you feel it as flatness before you feel it as fatigue.

variants.candidate: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Water makes it flow, and what goes in comes back later as instinct. As a catalyst, the intake falls short, so you trust a hunch ahead of sitting with what you know and give shelter you never take.
variants.original: Water is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is how you refill: quiet intake, reading, long conversations, time alone that lets impressions settle into understanding. Your thinking improves in direct proportion to your rest.

variants.candidate: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Fire makes it light, so whatever you do shows. As a catalyst, it opens too rarely, and you give quietly rather than perform what you are good at. You keep a talent waiting that deserves an audience.
variants.original: Fire is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is where what you have built becomes visible: presenting, hosting, putting your name on the work. Visibility feeds you more than you expect.

variants.candidate: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Metal makes it hard and exact, the finish growth needs. As a catalyst, the standard comes too seldom. You take charge in a crisis sooner than you earn a place, and leave most things unfinished.
variants.original: Metal is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is the standard that shapes your growth: editors, coaches, reviews, rules you chose on purpose. You improve fastest under exacting eyes.
